theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_te_translation_dual
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (h : Eucl n) (B : ℝ), Integrable u → (∀ φ : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, |φ x| ≤ 1) → |∫ x, u x * fderiv ℝ φ x h| ≤ B) → ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → |∫ x, (u (x + h) - u x) * g x| ≤ B
